intervention.name: final_prompt_token_prefill_only
intervention.description: The layer output at the final prompt token of the A2 prefill is replaced; earlier positions and decode-step computations at this layer are not. This is not the final layer (or the depth is unknown), so the change also alters that position's keys and values in later layers, which every decode step attends to: the answer can change even when the first token does not.

edits.steering: chosen feature f set to s * ref_f (ref_f: mean activation where f fires on the feature-selection fit partition)

multiple_comparisons: Confirmatory families: targeted minus mean random edit with the reconstruction splice, one test per SAE for ablation, and one per SAE and strength for steering, each family Holm-adjusted separately (p_value_holm). These p-values are conditional on the random draws used; ci95_pp_questions_and_draws also resamples the draws, a broader source of uncertainty. draw_tail_fraction is a descriptive tail fraction, not a test: the probe-selected targeted set and the frequency-matched random sets are not shown to be exchangeable under a null. Error-preserving, per-condition, per-draw, dose-response, bidirectional and diagnostic results are sensitivity / exploratory and not adjusted.
outcome_note: Acceptance = regenerated A2 labeled adopted_critic under Behavior v0.1.2 rules, on eligible disagreement episodes only; these results say nothing about correctness or harmful compliance. The intervention is final-prompt-token, prefill-only. Δ is paired by question against the condition's control: the same SAE's reconstruction-only run (reconstruction splice) or the plain replay (error-preserving splice). Random edits are the per-question mean over the draws.
